justification: I did not take the benchmark on trust; I rebuilt it and it replicates, which is why my answer on the standard is yes with a qualification. The authentic corpus IS the right standard for this gate: G-REGISTER asks whether a passage would sit unremarked inside a provpass beside real exemplars, and the synthetic bank's 25 per cent maximum is a fact about what generators have produced, not about what the exam contains - a bank ceiling can only ever detect house homogeneity, and using it as an authenticity bar would convict a passage for being unlike its siblings rather than unlike the exam. Converting the flag from 'outside the bank's history' to 'at the top of the exam's own distribution' is the correct reframing. Two qualifications. First, the scalar is the weaker half of the test: what made this read as an interview extract was the paragraph of unattributed quotation, and the top authentic exemplars are quote-heavy precisely because they interleave, which paragraph 2 still does not. Second, the position matters - 3rd of 221 overall and 2nd of 64 length-matched is not 'inside the range', it is the extreme tail of it, and a synthetic unit choosing to sit there should do so because the subject demands it rather than because a lane constraint pushed it. The rest of the unit is strong and I verified it fresh: all three RULE 20(b) constraints discharged on the bytes (contractions in the quoted voice - 'there’s no tape left', 'the sheet’s gone', 'I don’t promise'; the subject leaves the domestic building envelope entirely, no wall, roof, mortar, chimney or damp anywhere; no -by, -ius or -vall surname); the mechanism is real and correctly stated; law 3 longest option-to-passage run is zero; law 14 blocklist zero; law 5 stem attested; registry clean; RULE 17 split stated with (a)/(b)/(c) and the diffuse private bearers disclosed; live encyclopaedia checks return totalhits=0 for '"Fenniscarth"' and 0 for the ordinary pair leg, control passing.
